## Shared scenes

> During a church service, [Grace](../character/grace.md) interrupts the collection to publicly defend her father and clarify the misunderstanding behind their Sunday cleaning. The next day, she and Edmund ride pigs down Main Street, drawing mixed reactions from townspeople and the local doctor's family. Later, Miss Winifred visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to complain about Grace's antics, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends the child's brave intentions.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

> [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) encounters [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) by the hidden spring in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and crafts a birch cup for her to drink from. He walks her home while engaging in warm conversation, and she invites him into her house, where her sister [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) joins them in discussing global affairs.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P12](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P18](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0018), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P24](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0024)_

> [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) visits the [Ainslie](../character/ainslie.md) home and engages [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) in a lively political discussion about [Germany](../codex/places.md#germany) and the Kaiser while [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) looks for his book. After Ashdown departs, [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) warns [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) that the minister seems interested in courting her and reminds her of a promise she made. Irritated by the suggestion, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) dismisses Harriet's warnings and retires upstairs to her room feeling troubled.
>

> Mrs. [Twiss](../character/twiss.md) leaves the manse after scolding the children and Mr. Ashdown. Disturbed by her accusations about his parenting, Mr. Ashdown reflects on his children's needs and decides to seek company and comfort by visiting [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) and [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md).
>

> [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) walks through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) on his way to propose to [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), reflecting on his feelings for her and his reluctance to take a "suitable" second wife. Meanwhile, [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) prepares to hold [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to a past vow to reject him despite their fond mutual regard, leaving [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) anxious about turning him down.
>

> [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) returns home from a party after seeing [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) and pondering her feelings. Upon arriving, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) reveals that [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) proposed to her and asks [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) to release her from her vow never to abandon her. [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) steadfastly refuses, compelling [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to send Ashdown a cold written rejection, leaving both [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) and Ashdown heartbroken.
>

> [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) confronts [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and asks her to release her sister [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) from a vow so they can marry, which [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) willingly grants. Afterwards, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) returns home and informs [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) of her consent, but [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) insists she will not marry Lionel if [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) refuses to come live with them.
>
